LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.Waiting: Your guests are waiting for you to start the parade. They won't wait long, however.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.Description: A traditional ascension parade to send off the stellarch!
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.InvalidGuard: The stellarch does not trust {0} enough.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.LandingAreaUnmet: a landing pad for the guests' shuttle, marked out by four powered ship landing beacons
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.Reward.Label: Stellarch Ascension
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.Reward.Description: Your stellarch will achieve ascension with passage off-world to progress further in the grand hierarchy, serving directly with the Emperor
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.EndGame.Ending: The Imperial shuttle has carried {STELLARCH_nameDef} and everyone who ascended with {STELLARCH_objective} off this rimworld. From now on, {STELLARCH_pronoun} serves at the right hand of Emperor {EMPEROR_nameFull}.\n\nThe colony remains, and its story goes on.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.NoblesArriveInDesc: The shuttle carrying the nobility for the ascension parade lands in {0}. Until then, the colony has time to prepare. The nobles will not land while the stellarch is away, the colony is under threat or a landing pad the colony has built cannot be used, and if that lasts a day, the parade is called off.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.NoblesWaitingAwayDesc: The nobles for the ascension parade will not land until {STELLARCH_nameDef} is at the colony to receive them. If {STELLARCH_pronoun} is not back within {TIME}, the parade is called off.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.NoblesWaitingThreatDesc: The nobles for the ascension parade will not land while the colony is under threat. If the danger has not passed within {TIME}, the parade is called off.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.NoblesWaitingPadToo: Their shuttle cannot use your landing pad either:\n\n{PROBLEMS}
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.PadUnusableMessage: The nobles' shuttle will not land until your landing pad can be used: {0}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.PadUnformed: your ship landing beacons do not mark out a landing pad, which takes four of them at the corners of a rectangle with sides of {0} to {1} cells
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.CalledOffOn: Unless the nobles can land first, the parade is called off on {0}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.Drafted: The parade has stopped for {PAWN_nameDef}, who is drafted. If it waits {TIME} more in all, it fails.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.StellarchAway: The parade has stopped while {PAWN_nameDef} is away from it. If it waits {TIME} more in all, it fails.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.DraftTimeRunningOut: If the parade waits {TIME} more, it fails.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.DraftedTooLong: The parade waited too long, and has failed.
LanguageData.VFEE.Parade.Bombs: Deserters have planted {COUNT} bombs around the colony, each a different color, some of them in its most valuable rooms. They will go off in {TIME}, and each will destroy everything within 10 cells. Listen for the beeping and look for a flashing light.\n\nA colonist can defuse a bomb: select the colonist, then right-click the bomb.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.Arrived: A delegation from {FACTION_name} has come to pay its respects to {STELLARCH_nameDef} before {STELLARCH_possessive} ascension. They will tour the colony and leave in {DURATION}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.NoneCanCome: No faction friendly or neutral to you can send a delegation to {STELLARCH_nameDef}'s ascension, so none will come.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.Hostile: The delegation from {FACTION_name} will not come, now that they are hostile to you.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.CannotCome: The delegation from {FACTION_name} will not come, as they can no longer send one.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.HeldOff: The delegation from {FACTION_name} will not come. A group from {BLOCKER_name}, who are at war with them, stayed on the map until their time ran out.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.HeldOffByCondition: The delegation from {FACTION_name} will not come. The {CONDITION} kept them away until their time ran out.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.NoWayIn: The delegation from {FACTION_name} will not come, as they found no way into the colony. Visitors walk in from an edge of the map that is neither fogged nor roofed and has a path to the colony.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.OutOfTime: The delegation from {FACTION_name} will not come, as their time to visit has passed.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.LandedFirst: The nobles landed before every delegation had come, so these will not: {FACTIONS}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.DenounceDesc: Accuse {PAWN_nameDef} of being a deserter in disguise. A deserter will be exposed and attack at once, and so will any others hiding in the delegation. If {PAWN_nameDef} is innocent, {FACTION_name} will take offence: -{GOODWILL} goodwill.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.DenounceConfirm: Denounce {PAWN_nameDef} as a deserter?\n\nIf {PAWN_pronoun} is innocent, relations with {FACTION_name} will worsen by {GOODWILL}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.Assassin: {PAWN_nameFull} came with the delegation from {FACTION_name}, but is a deserter in disguise, and has drawn a smuggled weapon on {STELLARCH_nameDef}!
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.AssassinExposed: You were right about {PAWN_nameFull}, who came with the delegation from {FACTION_name} as a deserter in disguise. Exposed, the deserter has drawn a smuggled weapon and is going for {STELLARCH_nameDef}!
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.Cell: {NAMES} came with the delegation from {FACTION_name}, but are deserters in disguise, and have drawn smuggled weapons on {STELLARCH_nameDef} together!
LanguageData.VFEE.Delegation.CellExposed: You were right, and that deserter was not alone: {NAMES} came with the delegation from {FACTION_name} in disguise. Exposed, they have drawn smuggled weapons and are all going for {STELLARCH_nameDef}!
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.StrikeWithAllies: {BRUTUS_nameFull} has turned on {STELLARCH_nameDef}, with {ALLIES} at {BRUTUS_possessive} side!
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.StrikeGuards: They are going for {STELLARCH_possessive} guards first, then for {STELLARCH_objective}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.StrikeGuardsAlone: {BRUTUS_nameDef} is going for {STELLARCH_possessive} guards first, then for {STELLARCH_objective}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.StrikeRules: The deserters will leave the plotters alone. If {BRUTUS_nameDef} falls before {STELLARCH_nameDef} does, the plot fails and the others surrender. If {STELLARCH_nameDef} dies, what happens next is your decision.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.StrikeRulesAlone: The deserters will leave {BRUTUS_objective} alone. If {BRUTUS_nameDef} falls before {STELLARCH_nameDef} does, the plot fails. If {STELLARCH_nameDef} dies, what happens next is your decision.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.FoiledBrutusStopped: {BRUTUS_nameDef} has been stopped, and the plot against {STELLARCH_nameDef} has failed.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.FoiledOutOfReach: {STELLARCH_nameDef} is out of the plotters' reach, and their plot has failed.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.FoiledSurrendered: The others have dropped their weapons and surrendered: {ALLIES}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.FoiledEveryoneSurrendere: The plotters have dropped their weapons and surrendered: {ALLIES}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.GuiltyForGood: Every plotter stays guilty for good, and can be executed at any time.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.TraitorsAmongUs: While any of them lives in the colony, {STELLARCH_nameDef} and everyone who loves {STELLARCH_objective} will be unhappy, for up to 60 days. Banishing or executing them ends it.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.Decision:
{STELLARCH_nameFull} is dead, and the ascension has failed. The plot led by {BRUTUS_nameFull} has won, and how it ends is your decision.

Traitors: {BRUTUS_nameDef} and the other plotters go over to the deserters, to be hunted down. They will go for the nobles still here as well.

The deal: the Empire accepts {BRUTUS_nameDef} as {STELLARCH_possessive} successor, with {STELLARCH_possessive} honor at once and {STELLARCH_possessive} title at a bestowing ceremony. Every other adult colonist here stays loyal to {STELLARCH_objective}, goes over to the deserters and fights the plotters to the last. Children and slaves hide until the fighting is over.

Truce: everyone stands down and stays, and {STELLARCH_possessive} title goes to {STELLARCH_possessive} heir. For 60 days, colonists who loved {STELLARCH_objective} will be unhappy, and those who despised {STELLARCH_objective} glad.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.DecisionBrutusOpinion: Everyone will think less of {BRUTUS_nameDef} for as long as {BRUTUS_pronoun} stays in the colony.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.DecisionBrutusOpinionNor: Everyone will think less of {BRUTUS_nameDef} for the same 60 days.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.DecisionTruceBreaks: If a colonist kills one of the plotters, the truce is broken and the rest go over to the deserters.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.Traitors: The plotters have gone over to the deserters: {CONSPIRATORS}. They will fight to the last, and go for the nobles still here as well.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.TraitorsAlone: {BRUTUS_nameDef} has gone over to the deserters, and will fight to the last, going for the nobles still here as well.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.Deal: The Empire accepts {BRUTUS_nameDef} as {STELLARCH_nameDef}'s successor. The colonists who stayed loyal to {STELLARCH_objective} have gone over to the deserters, and will fight the plotters to the last: {LOYALISTS}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.DealNoLoyalists: The Empire accepts {BRUTUS_nameDef} as {STELLARCH_nameDef}'s successor, and nobody here stayed loyal to {STELLARCH_objective}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.DealHiding: The children and slaves are hiding until the fighting is over.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.Truce: Everyone stands down. {STELLARCH_nameDef}'s title passes to {STELLARCH_possessive} heir, and the plotters stay in the colony, guilty for good: {CONSPIRATORS}. If a colonist kills one of them, the truce is broken and the rest go over to the deserters.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.TruceAlone: Everyone stands down. {STELLARCH_nameDef}'s title passes to {STELLARCH_possessive} heir, and {BRUTUS_nameDef} stays in the colony, guilty for good.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.TruceNoneLeft: Everyone stands down, and {STELLARCH_nameDef}'s title passes to {STELLARCH_possessive} heir. None of the plotters is left alive.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.TruceBroken: {KILLER_nameDef} has killed {VICTIM_nameDef}, and the truce after {STELLARCH}'s death is broken. The other plotters have gone over to the deserters: {CONSPIRATORS}.
LanguageData.VFEE.Conspiracy.FightOver: The fighting is over, and the children and slaves who sat it out are coming out of hiding.
LanguageData.VFEE.Ascension.Difficulty:
{STELLARCH_nameDef}'s ascension is about to be announced across the realm. For five days, delegations will come to pay their respects, and then the nobility will land for the parade. Not everyone who comes will wish {STELLARCH_objective} well, and not every danger will come from outside the colony. Keep {STELLARCH_objective} guarded day and night, from now until {STELLARCH_pronoun} boards the shuttle.

How dangerous should it be? This cannot be changed later.

Normal: fewer of {STELLARCH_possessive} enemies will dare to strike.

Losing is fun: all of them will.
LanguageData.VFEE.AssassinationSuccess: Deserters are leaving as they have eliminated their target.
LanguageData.VFEE.RoyaltyDead: Deserters are leaving as they have eliminated every imperial title holder in the area.
LanguageData.VFEE.GotDrug: {0} has sent you a celebration package of aperitif!
LanguageData.VFEE.TitheArrived: The tithe of {0} has arrived from {1}.
